name: Delhivery

SDE-1.dsaDepth: Light–Moderate - 1–2 Easy/Medium DSA problems per round, several short rounds
rounds: Online coding round (30–90 min): usually 1–2 problems plus some MCQs
Technical/face-to-face round(s): further DSA plus resume and project questions
HR round: basic profile and motivation questions
extraTopics: Core CS: OS, DBMS, computer networks
Some rounds are as short as 30–45 minutes
SDE-1.notes: Loop length varies: reports range from 1 round to 4 rounds.

SDE-2.dsaDepth: Moderate - DSA plus system/low-level design, resume-driven
rounds: Technical round(s): DSA plus resume/experience deep-dive
System design or low-level design round
extraTopics: Resume-driven questioning on past tools and technologies
SDE-2.notes: Documented by fewer reports than SDE-1; treat as indicative.
